html:
Unique Research · Insight / IPO Filing · June 15, 2022 · Full rewrite — not a stub

On May 20, 2022, CB digital marketing group Powerwin Tech (力盟科技) (founded 2013; GF Securities HK sole sponsor) filed HKEX Main Board prospectus — first filing; no pre-IPO PE. China’s #3 ecom CB digital marketing / #5 overall CB digital marketing vendor. ’21 rev $14.35M (+22.8%), NI $5.78M (−2%), GM 84.8%; ’19–’21 rev $9.53M / $11.69M / $14.35M (CAGR ~23%). ~1,600 advertisers; partners Google, Twitter, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, Snapchat + 19 top publishers; 240+ countries; ~440B impressions / 11B clicks in track record. Top-5 clients ~60% of rev. CB digital marketing market $22.3B ’21 → $51.1B ’25 (23% CAGR). Charts in CN images — attach on ingest.

— END —
